neighbours.label: The word after a comma splice, where a new clause starts with no conjunction (', you have to', ', this is', ', you can'); the same clauses joined by a conjunction or relative stay quiet
fire: You can't give up now, you have to keep going.
That's okay, you can pay me on Friday.
The real problem is the price, this is what hurts us.
It is just as bad, you just paid more for it.
I know him well, he is very shy.
We missed the bus, it was already gone.
The plan is no longer needed, the lawyers say.
She looked at me, she said nothing.
